feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 738 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Brevo Contacts CSV Check — Find Import Errors Before You Import
entry.summary: Free Brevo (Sendinblue) contacts import CSV checker: finds invalid and duplicate emails, rows with neither email nor SMS, SMS numbers with no country code or ruined by Excel, unquoted commas that shift columns, mixed date formats and near-miss column names, with line numbers, and applies formatting-only safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.
